title: perf: eliminate redundant file read and frontmatter re-parse in buildJobs
body:
`CompileSimpleWorkflow` regressed ~16.7% (1.47ms → 1.71ms). Profiling identified two redundant allocation hot spots per compilation.

## Changes

- **Eliminate redundant disk I/O in `buildJobs`** — the function was calling `os.ReadFile` + `parser.ExtractFrontmatterFromContent` on every compilation to obtain frontmatter, despite `data.RawFrontmatter` already holding the identical parsed result. The consumers (`needsRoleCheck`, `hasWorkflowRunTrigger`) only inspect event keys in the `on` field, which are unaffected by `preprocessScheduleFields`.

  ```go
  // Before: re-read file + re-parse YAML on every compile
  if diskContent, err := os.ReadFile(markdownPath); err == nil { ... }
  parser.ExtractFrontmatterFromContent(rawContent)

  // After: use already-parsed data
  frontmatter := data.RawFrontmatter
  ```

- **Skip unnecessary map copy in `copyFrontmatterWithoutInternalMarkers`** — the function always allocated a new map even when no `__gh_aw_native_label_filter__` markers were present. Added a fast-path check that returns the original map directly for the common case (workflows without label-filtered events).

## Benchmark

| Metric | Before | After | Δ |
|--------|--------|-------|---|
| Time | 1,505 ns/op | 1,421 ns/op | **−5.6%** |
| Memory | 1,065 kB/op | 1,041 kB/op | −2.3% |
| Allocations | 5,508/op | 5,062/op | **−8.1%** |
